note: remote store; skills registered with the host, ownership-scoped; three upstream fixes ported from 2.31.1-2.31.3; BM25 lexical channel and rank fusion (OPENCODE_MEM_RRF=1), lexical ranking and the fusion itself computed globally over all shards, tokenized corpus cached; query text carried into the shard search; MCP over HTTP on POST /mcp; tier-aware aging sweep (POST /api/sweep) with a reversible tombstone; capture summary: the internal session is created the way the free tier accepts it and falls back to a session message; shadow index for a second embedding model (POST /api/reindex); per-client keys with a scope; a profile identity can be moved to another machine (POST /api/user-profile/transfer)
